description: Timestamped, signed proof that a file or text existed and was submitted by your wallet at this moment: send a sha256 (or the text / base64 and we hash it) and get back a statement (hash, label, wallet, UTC time) with an EIP-191 signature from AgentRXI's published key. Verify offline forever with any secp256k1 library. Only the hash is seen when you send one. $0.003. Costs $0.003 USDC per call (x402).
